name: Disable NX / DEP
description: Disables NX/DEP protection in boot settings to allow legacy software that does not support this security feature. This reduces system-level memory safety and should only be used for specific compatibility issues.

description_i18n.en: Disables NX/DEP protection in boot settings to allow legacy software that does not support this security feature. This reduces system-level memory safety and should only be used for specific compatibility issues.
description_i18n.de: Deaktiviert den NX/DEP-Schutz im Boot-Verlauf, um veraltete Software zu ermöglichen, die diese Sicherheitsfunktion nicht unterstützt. Dies verringert die Sicherheit des Systems und sollte nur für spezifische Kompatibilitätsprobleme verwendet werden.
description_i18n.fr: Désactive la protection NX/DEP dans les paramètres de démarrage pour permettre aux logiciels obsolètes qui ne prennent pas en charge cette fonctionnalité de sécurité. Cela réduit la sécurité du système et doit être utilisé uniquement pour des problèmes de compatibilité spécifiques.

warnings.title: Security protection reduced
warnings.message: Disabling NX/DEP reduces memory safety protections. This may allow certain types of exploits to succeed and should only be used when absolutely necessary for legacy software

warnings.title: System
warnings.message: A system reboot is mandatory before the new boot configuration takes effect. All running applications will close during this process

compatibility.notes: Designed for supported Windows desktop systems.

technical_details: Modifies the Windows Boot Configuration Data (BCD) by setting or removing the 'nx AlwaysOff' value for the current boot entry
